Name: One Quiet Cup of Thunder
Desc: The Max Hits Per Action for "Lightning-Lord" increases by <unbreak>6[i]</unbreak>. When Lightning-Lord's Hits Per Action reaches its upper limit, it immediately takes action. At the start of combat and after every <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> time(s) "Lightning-Lord" takes action, "Lightning-Lord" gets enhanced, and Jing Yuan's DMG dealt increases by <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak>. When using Skill/Ultimate, additionally increases Lightning-Lord's Hits Per Action by <unbreak>3[i]</unbreak>/<unbreak>4[i]</unbreak> respectively, lasting for <unbreak>5[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
